newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 3.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Parliamentary select committee studying the government's devolution proposals will complete work by March, Justice and Constitutional Affairs Minister Gamini Lakshman Peiris says.
The Board of Investment says apparel sector will generate 20,000 new jobs this year.
Journalists protest detention of private television network director by police under the Prevention of Terrorism Act for allegedly broadcasting a false news item.
Security forces in northern Jaffna peninsula kill Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam's (LTTE) eastern Batticaloa leader Major Raju.
Troops of "Operation Rivijaya" smash several abandoned camps of the LTTE as they continue march forward in eastern Batticaloa district.
Mine explosion in Jaffna kill six soldiers, including three women soldiers, and three civilians.
